'''Brukes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where she dispensed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades to agents of the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ensign Brukes first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Starship Upgrades vendor aboard Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
